purpose: Bounded optional batching of raw teacher IDs, logits and LSE into registered Host tensors
change: teacher_d2h_batch_tokens defaults to 1; larger values share max_device_bytes with KV staging across all local slots.
Only the aux owner allocates teacher staging, including aux-only PP stages using the target pool device.
Short ranges own source values immediately, full batches and sealed tails copy to Host, and large ranges bypass staging.
CPU P/D teacher rows stay on Host; append/flush/reuse follows a single row ledger and explicit CUDA stream fences.
Terminal trim limits manifest rows; abort discards unpublished tails; uncertain completion quarantines both arenas.
Trace attribution now includes correlated D2D separately from D2H, with unknown byte fields preserved.
